decisions.reason: As a newly launched flagship product line close to the core software business and publicly framed as part of the firm's direction, management is very likely to continue backing it and interpret any early issues as temporary.

Because the education institute builds on the firm's training capabilities and customer relationships, a growing firm with broad offerings is more likely to retain it for now despite its lower visibility than the flagship software line.
The remote support tool fits the firm's established service and support model, so even with less public commitment than Product A, management would usually keep it in the market at this early stage.
